blurb: Guests attend a three-day festival with hot air balloon launches at dawn, tethered balloon rides, and a night glow event at sunset, weather permitting. The festival also includes live entertainment, a carnival, artisan vendors, food and beverage vendors, and kids activities. Balloon flights are available for purchase separately through Portland Rose Balloons.
extraNote: 3-day pass must be purchased in advance online; no single day tickets · Parking passes not sold in advance; parking fee supports local charities · Balloon activities suspended if raining or wind too strong (above 8-10 mph) · Tethered rides are first come first served and depend on fuel availability · Refunds for tickets purchased before Legacy Ticket promotion available until July 8 · Cook Family Park, Tigard, Oregon; balloon activities on Nicoli Athletic Fields near 92nd Ave · June 26–28, 2026
